topic: How does the 45° scan range affect link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage users compared to broadside beams?
consensus_response: A 45° scan range impacts link budgets differently for EOC and broadside beams.  EOC users experience increased interference due to wider scans, requiring more bandwidth to maintain acceptable signal quality. Broadside beams offer better direct communication with fewer beam overlaps, leading to higher link budgets. Antenna design plays a crucial role by optimizing gain across different beam types to mitigate multipath fading in EOC scenarios.
